segments.text: Good morning class. Today we continue with motion. Remember, time is change. The SI unit of time is
the second. Now, velocity is not the same as speed. Average velocity is displacement divided
by the time of travel. So if a car moves 100 meters east in 20 seconds, its average velocity
is 5 meters per second east. Speed has no direction. For homework, please solve questions
3 to 6 from section 2.3 and bring your notebooks on Monday.

summary: Time is change; the SI unit of time is the second.
Velocity differs from speed because velocity includes direction.
Average velocity equals displacement divided by the time of travel.
A car moving 100 meters east in 20 seconds has 5 meters per second east velocity.
